identity.title: [v0.92.1][TAIL-06.14][security] Require SSH recovery for public Spot Runtime

values.summary: Static remediation implemented and ten mocked Terraform plan tests pass. Saved AWS plan is read-only evidence. Live SSH reachability, application isolation and disposal remain pending explicit cloud approval and selected identity-file path.
actual_changes: Require key and explicit SSH ingress for public Spot Runtime.
Preserve application isolation, reject Runtime/SSH port overlap, retain IMDSv2 and encrypted storage.
Provide focused mock tests, recovery documentation and an unexecuted live probe helper.

actual_validation.purpose: Public SSH negative/positive and hardening contract proof
